name: Elah
overview: The name Elah appears in Scripture with multiple references, including a notable king of Israel who succeeded his father Baasha and reigned briefly before being assassinated by his servant Zimri, as detailed in 1 Kings 16:6-10. Additionally, Elah is identified as an Edomite duke, illustrating the name's use among regional leaders (Genesis 36:41). The varied mentions of Elah reflect its significance both as a personal name and a title connected to leadership and lineage in biblical history.
